# Looking up a row in Google Sheets: locate the spreadsheet, then match exactly

Procedure for tasks that require reading or finding data in a Google Sheet.

1. First list/search available spreadsheets to get the exact spreadsheet and
   worksheet IDs — do not assume names.
2. Read the header row to learn the actual column names before filtering.
3. Use the lookup/search tool with the exact column name and value from the task;
   prefer exact matches, and fall back to scanning rows only for fuzzy criteria.
4. If multiple rows match, re-read the task for a disambiguating field
   (date, status, owner) before picking one.
5. Carry values forward exactly as they appear in the sheet (IDs, emails, amounts) —
   downstream steps are checked against the sheet's literal contents.

messages.subject: Content Expiration Priority Window Update
messages.body_plain:
Team,

Content Expiration Alerts Policy Update - Q1 2026

Section 1: Overview
This update revises our content expiration alerting thresholds to better align with our publishing pipeline lead times.

Section 2: Scope
This policy applies to all content expiration alerts sent to content owners for assets tracked in the Content Library spreadsheet.

Section 3: Alert Categories
Content expiration alerts are categorized into two priority tiers: Urgent and Standard. Each tier triggers different response SLAs from content owners.

Section 4: Standard Priority Window
Assets expiring in 6 to 30 days from the alert date are classified as Standard priority. Standard assets should be reviewed and renewed within 5 business days of receiving the alert.

Section 5: Urgent Priority Window
Effective Q1 2026, the urgent priority threshold is updated from 7 days to 5 days. Assets expiring within 5 days of the alert date must be labeled Priority: Urgent. Assets expiring in 6 or more days should be labeled Priority: Standard. Reference code: CXPA-PRI-Q1. Include this code in alert emails that use the updated priority classification.

Section 6: Transition Period
Any prior communications referencing a 7-day urgent window are superseded by this update. Please apply the 5-day threshold going forward.

Section 7: Questions
Contact content-director@company.example.com with any questions.

- Content Director
